kind: build + offline tests (ratification fix rounds 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 applied)

claude plugin validate ..note: does not check hook event names

versions.jev_server: fake stdio server (private/jev-control/test/fixtures/fake-control-server.mjs); no real Jev server was used

fix_round_1.audit: coverage is bound to concrete grants (plan item action hashes, search hits, bound approvals); no generic slots; order, request, agent context and reuse are checked; tokens are unknown when a field is missing in some messages
fix_round_1.search: find, rerank and the tie-break draw from one budget of 2 evaluations per search id, reserved atomically; tie_unresolved returns only resolved_hits; real attempts reported; raw scores
fix_round_1.actions_and_receipts: options carry an action descriptor and preconditions; plan items carry the raw score and the action hash; receipts carry full provenance and authorize exactly the planned action once
fix_round_1.compaction: plan and scores are paged with explicit markers (plan_next, scores_next) and `cli.mjs page`; scores stay raw
fix_round_1.contracts: tools/list schemas are validated field by field against the published schema (types, required, limits, auto_accept); results are checked for association and consistency; verified against the real server's tools/list
fix_round_1.identity_and_lifecycle: a per-session capability injected by the hook replaces the repository-wide binding; startup/resume/clear/fork and SessionEnd switch the mode off; SessionEnd is registered in hooks/hooks.json
fix_round_1.runner: one campaign-wide exclusive lock taken before spawn; the no-progress stop is removed
fix_round_1.left_for_R02: CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID in the Bash tool; raw slash text in the prompt hook and the capability line reaching the model; the model copying the capability into subagent prompts; agent_id in subagent payloads; SessionEnd firing; /jev:jev-control in claude -p; --plugin-dir with an installed jev plugin

fix_round_2.actions: the descriptor is tool, exact target and the canonical arguments per tool (Write content, Edit old/new string, Read offset/limit, Agent model and prompt, Grep scope, ...); payloads are bound by SHA-256; a missing required argument or an unknown name is refused; Jev sees the sanitized concrete variant; receipt verify takes the whole action
fix_round_2.receipts: before the first use any move of the tree invalidates; later steps need the evidence paths they depend on unchanged (fingerprinted at decision time) and a step that names none is refused as stale
fix_round_2.audit: refused receipts revoke grants; search grants keep range, hash and rank; only a genuine helper invocation with a plausible output grants; every done attempt replaces the finalization state and an edit after acceptance invalidates it; Incomplete: is told apart from a declared completion; a budget raise needs the user's words in the request; reservations are bound to the agent context
fix_round_2.commit_trailer: first fix commit message amended to Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (tree unchanged)

fix_round_3.authorization: budget approve and approve need words that are an authorization (not a quoted negation, refusal, question or condition); --n capped at the quantity the words state (25 when none); the same words are spent once per request; the audit judges the whole sentence, spends each user sentence once and caps the raise
fix_round_3.pipe_feeders: only cat, echo and printf may feed the helper through a pipe; any other feeder makes the command an audited action
fix_round_3.verification_validity: receipt_verified only when nothing that may change the tree (edit, Bash, agent, unclassified tool) happened between the verification and the action; otherwise unverified_binding
fix_round_3.done_attempts: a done result updates the finalization only for the latest started attempt of its request; late results are stale_results
fix_round_3.what_jev_reads: the whole sanitized concrete action is sent (noul context item, tie-break evidence, rerank candidate text); a batch is split over several noul calls when it does not fit; a tie-break that does not fit stops (action_material_too_large); an action sanitizing cannot show whole is action_material_omitted and not scored; hashes only in receipts, state and plan

fix_round_4.authorization_object: a budget raise needs a granting sentence about the budget, an option approval one that names the option; quotations and unrelated instructions are not authorizations; a short answer counts only with the question it answers (--question for the helper, the real AskUserQuestion question for the audit)
fix_round_4.authorization_identity: an authorization is spent by source message and sentence indexes; the helper treats words contained in an earlier approval's words as the same authorization
fix_round_4.total_vs_increment: a total (to N, N in total) is measured against the limit in force; an increment (by N, N more) is added; an ambiguous number raises nothing
fix_round_4.finalization_mutations: Bash, Agent, Task and unclassified tools after an accepted done invalidate it (changed_after_accepted); Incomplete stays a legitimate stop

fix_round_9.later_sentences: closed world: every later sentence must be the same approval again (same scope and quantity), plain politeness from a closed set (thanks, thank you, please, ok, okay, great, cheers, mersi, mulțumesc, te rog, ...) or empty; anything else, short or long, voids the approval; refusals and RETRACT remain additional reasons
fix_round_9.quoted_retraction: judge (helper) and findAuthorizations (audit) share contextAllows: the approval sentences are identified inside the quotation and every other sentence of the message is context, so a retraction quoted with the approval voids it; two approval sentences with different quantities contradict
fix_round_9.approval_position: the approval must be the last substantial sentence of the message, otherwise the user is asked again

tests.control: 418 tests, 77 suites (new cases are assertions in existing tests)

fix_round_8.whole_message_context: findAuthorizations reads every other sentence of the source message: one that talks about the scope (budget noun, number, option id) must itself be a complete approval with the same quantity, before or after the quoted sentence; a ceiling, restriction or contradicting approval voids it; order is no revocation
fix_round_8.later_sentences: a later refused, explicitly retracting, or short (<=3 words, not plain thanks) sentence voids the approval; a long unrelated sentence or plain thanks does not

fix_round_7.existing_budget_is_not_a_raise: a budget approval must also approve a raise or going beyond the limit (raise verb, more/extra/another, past/beyond/over, a number); 'Continue with the current budget.' and 'Spend the current budget.' raise nothing; the default step applies only to a demonstrable raise
fix_round_7.source_message_context: findAuthorizations judges a quoted fragment in the context of the whole source message: a later refused, retracting, narrowing or scope-mentioning non-approval sentence voids it; a later approval or an unrelated sentence does not

fix_round_6.whole_sentence_approval: a budget approval is lead words + a budget verb + only the budget, a quantity and fillers; an option approval is lead words + a granting verb + the id + politeness (an exclusion clause is cut off first); any word saying what the approval is for (testing, discussing, evaluating, another id) leaves the sentence unrecognized; a list in one sentence is not read
fix_round_6.question_binding: a bare yes completes only a one-sentence question that is itself a complete approval of the scope; an answer that selects an option concerns that option alone; a yes to alternatives authorizes none

tests.control: 414 tests, 77 suites (new cases are assertions in existing tests)

fix_round_5.grant_aimed_at_target: a budget grant is a budget verb within four words of the limit/calls (or 'N more calls'); 'Jev' is not an object; an option grant is a granting word within four words before the id with no exclusion (instead of, rather than, over, except) and no other identifier in between; the question of a short answer is judged the same way; unreadable formulations are refused
fix_round_5.quantity: no number = default step; zero = quantum_zero; fraction/negative/grouped = quantum_invalid; ambiguous = quantum_ambiguous; a stated quantity never becomes the default
fix_round_5.finalization_without_done: evident changes (edit tool, Bash that visibly writes) without a current accepted done are completion_declared_without_accepted_done when completion is declared, also with no prior done and no edit tool; possible changes (other Bash, Agent/Task, unclassified tools) are unknown possible_changes_unvalidated
